## Checks

- [ ] Every fixture and example is made up; nothing comes from a real document or company.
- [ ] The engine tests pass; skipped checks and environmental failures are listed.
- [ ] The public-source and documentation-link checks pass.
- [ ] A new sanitizer or verifier step is registered and proven by a fixture that fails without it.
- [ ] User-visible changes and component contracts are updated if behaviour changed.
- [ ] Contributions can be distributed under Apache-2.0; applicable third-party attribution is retained.
